statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 applies to the unmaintained golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package. The committed and release dependency graphs contain only golang.org/x/crypto/md4 and golang.org/x/crypto/ripemd160; openpgp is neither imported nor compiled into the product. Linux govulncheck source analysis reports zero reachable and zero imported-package vulnerabilities.
